description: This file defines the FormCache class responsible for caching form data and form state in Drupal, including methods for retrieving, setting, loading, and deleting cache entries, as well as handling form include files and cache validation.

classes.name: FormCache
classes.description: Encapsulates the caching of a form and its form state in Drupal, providing methods to get, set, load, and delete cached form data, and handling form include files and cache validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the FormCache class, initializing dependencies such as key value factory, module handler, current user, CSRF token generator, logger, request stack, and request policy.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached form data if available and valid, based on form build ID and form state.

methods.name: loadCachedFormState
methods.description: Loads the cached form state and includes any associated files or modules needed for the form.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores form data and form state in cache with expiration, ensuring form build ID consistency and adding cache tokens.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Deletes cached form data and form state based on form build ID.
